messages:
ana (PM): quick thread — need a compact SLA appendix for BYOK availability and audit exports. customer wants clear credits + an escrow option. what can we promise?

mike (Eng-Sec): reality check: automated KMS failover is ~5m typical; full tenant exports vary 10-60m. manual escrow is hours and ops-heavy.

sasha (Legal): prefer tiered service credits (no cash penalties). include exclusions: legal hold, customer key compromise, third-party KMS outages. cap per-incident and annual.

devin (AE): customers will push for tighter windows. suggest a purchasable "priority compliance lane" for 24h export SLA and faster ops response.

tina (CS): auditors expect an export manifest: export_id, tenant, timestamp, object list, checksum, signed_by, operator_id. need a runbook to produce artifacts within 5 business days.

ana (PM): action items: 1) legal/product draft credit table this week, 2) eng estimate failover tests + manifest tooling (1w), 3) eng prototype resumable export (Q4 stretch), 4) cs collect 3 customer asks (EOD). syncing Fri AM to review.
